incidents.title: Roswell Crash Retrieval & Foster Ranch Debris Field

anomalies: Memory foil structural resilience
Inflexible lightweight I-beams with glyphs
Total military cordon and press retraction issued within 24 hours

Extremely dense honeycombed aluminum-magnesium alloy
Occupant suited in seamless dark fabric

incidents.title: Tehran Iran F-4 Phantom Weapons Lock Incident

anomalies: Target radiated intense primary radar return equivalent to Boeing 707
Selective electronic shutdown of weapons bus without tripping circuit breakers

incidents.title: Kecksburg Acorn Craft Crash & Flatbed Transport
incidents.officialNarrative: Mid-sized bolide meteor fragment that disintegrated completely upon atmospheric entry.
incidents.investigativeHypothesis: Bronze/gold acorn-shaped craft (10–12 ft) found embedded in soft loam with no wings or engine openings. Encircling the base was a raised band with embossed symbols resembling ancient Egyptian hieroglyphics. Loaded onto military flatbed under tarp and whisked to Lockbourne AFB.
anomalies: Vehicle banked and made controlled 90-degree turn before crash landing
Raised bumper band with Egyptian-like cuneiform/pictographs
NASA lost all original analysis records and soil telemetry from the site

incidents.title: Socorro New Mexico Police Officer Lonnie Zamora Encounter
militaryUnits: White Sands Missile Range Military Police
Project Blue Book (Dr. J. Allen Hynek)
incidents.officialNarrative: Unsolved. Case classified as Unidentified by Dr. J. Allen Hynek and Major Hector Quintanilla.
incidents.investigativeHypothesis: Police officer chased speeding car, heard roaring sound, and found shiny white egg/oval craft resting on four angled girders. Two small figures in white coveralls stood beside it. Craft fired blue/orange conical flame with no smoke and ascended silently.
anomalies: Four wedge-shaped landing gear indentations pressed 3 inches into dry soil
Charred and burning creosote bushes at center of landing site
Red crest insignia (arrow within inverted crescent) painted on vehicle hull

sources.title: Project Blue Book Special Report on Socorro (Dr. J. Allen Hynek)

incidents.title: Chicago O'Hare Gate C17 Cloud-Punching Saucer
incidents.classification: FAA OFFICIAL RECORD / NARCAP TECHNICAL REPORT
incidents.officialNarrative: A 'hole-punch cloud' atmospheric weather phenomenon or optical illusion.
incidents.investigativeHypothesis: Dark metallic disc (approx. 25ft diameter) hovered motionless for 15 minutes at 1,900 ft directly above United Gate C17. Suddenly shot straight up into overcast stratus cloud layer at astronomical velocity, leaving a crisp, circular blue-sky hole that remained open for 14 minutes.
anomalies: Punched clean physical circular hole through dense cloud deck
Seen by dozen airline pilots, mechanics, and supervisors with identical descriptions
FAA initial refusal to investigate overturned by FOIA tape releases

sources.title: Chicago Tribune (Jon Hilkevitch): In The Sky! A Bird? A Plane? A UFO?
